papers.title: Dislocations after use of dual-mobility cups in cementless primary total hip arthroplasty: prospective multicentre series

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文是临床结局研究，不涉及股骨柄的应力遮挡、微动或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical case series on dislocation rates after total hip arthroplasty with dual-mobility cups; it does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical parameters relevant to femoral stem design or FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估双动杯在全髋置换术中的脱位率
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性多中心病例系列分析

summary_en.motivation: This study aimed to prospectively evaluate the dislocation rate after primary total hip arthroplasty using a dual-mobility cup.
summary_en.method: A prospective multicentre series of patients receiving cementless primary THA with dual-mobility cups was analyzed for complications.
summary_en.result: The dual-mobility cup showed a low dislocation rate at follow-up.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up without biomechanical testing or FE modeling.
